description: Create a demand curve from 12 monthly weights (January-first). The server normalizes the points to mean 1.0 before persisting, so attaching the curve can never change an item's annual forecast volume by itself. curveType: Seasonal (repeats every year, calendar-anchored) or Lifecycle (plays once from each item's launch/anchor date — launch ramps, promos, end-of-life). Creating only adds a reusable shape; nothing is forecast-affecting until the curve is applied with apply_demand_curve_to_items.

curveType.description: Seasonal (repeats annually) or Lifecycle (one-shot from an anchor date).

description.description: Optional description of when to use this curve.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

points.description: Exactly 12 non-negative monthly weights, January first. Relative values — the server normalizes them to average 1.0.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is created until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
